Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If I play Political Seizure to contest a "targeted location", can
I choose the target if the other methuselah yields?

By The Rack's card text, this is already taken care of.

But what happens if I play Political Seizure to contest a Palatial
Estate? When I gain control of it, can I choose a new minion to place it
onto?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> If I play Political Seizure to contest a "targeted location", can
> I choose the target if the other methuselah yields?

Yes.

> By The Rack's card text, this is already taken care of.
>
> But what happens if I play Political Seizure to contest a Palatial
> Estate? When I gain control of it, can I choose a new minion to place it
> onto?

Yes.

Loquipment may be put on any ready minion if moved in an ambiguous fashion (by
Disputed Territory, e.g.). If the new controller has no minions, the locquipment
is burned. (Note: currently all moves are ambiguous - TOM). [RTR 19960112]
